State police and CAPF officer exams
Central and state governments, through public service commissions and UPSC.
A general graduate degree and a competitive exam. UPSC CAPF (Assistant Commandant) 2026 listed 349 posts for ages 20 to 25.
Cyber-fraud and financial-crime analysis (banks, fintechs, advisory firms)
Scalable with a business layer NCRB recorded 86,420 cyber crime cases in 2023, about 69% of them fraud. Fraud-analysis skill can later be sold as consulting or training.
Corporate risk, fraud and due-diligence work
Scalable with a business layer A small advisory practice can charge per assignment once clients trust your reports.
Research, policy briefs and crime-data writing (think tanks, NGOs, your own newsletter)
Scalable with a business layer Reach grows with an audience you own. Paid research and training come from that audience.
Training and awareness sessions (cyber fraud, child safety, workplace safety)
Scalable with a business layer A repeatable session can be priced as a package and delivered by others later.
Prison, probation and correctional services
Not so scalable NCRB counted 1,468 sanctioned correctional posts and 820 filled at the end of 2022. The need is real, but pay follows a fixed government scale.
State police and CAPF officer exams
Not so scalable Several filters in a row (written test, physical test, interview, then promotion). Criminology is not the entry key.

You picture detective work and profiling
India has no large employer base for profilers. Most criminology work is reading data, writing reports and handling files. Test that daily work before you pay for it.
You need a fixed salary within a year of graduating
No post is reserved for criminology graduates. The first job usually comes from a second skill, an internship, or an exam that does not ask for criminology at all.
You dislike statistics and long reports
Every paid route here runs on numbers or written analysis. A student who avoids both will struggle in the degree and in the job.
You want lab work on DNA, toxicology or digital evidence
That is forensic science, a different degree with a different entry requirement. Read the forensic science verdict instead.
You want to be a licensed counsellor or clinical psychologist
That path runs through psychology and a licensing board. Criminology is a side layer there.
